description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptReferenceTerm class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods related to concept reference term mappings.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermTest
classes.description: Test class for the ConceptReferenceTerm class, containing unit tests for adding term mappings and handling duplicates.

methods.name: addConceptReferenceTermMap_shouldSetTermAAsTheTermToWhichAMappingIsBeingAdded
methods.description: Tests that adding a concept reference term map correctly sets termA in the map.

methods.name: addConceptReferenceTermMap_shouldNotAddAMapWhereTermBIsItself
methods.description: Ensures that a concept reference term map is not added if termB is the same as the term itself.

methods.name: addConceptReferenceTermMap_shouldNotAddDuplicateConceptReferenceTermMaps
methods.description: Checks that duplicate concept reference term maps are not added to the term.
